rationale: Long category names rotated -45 degrees at a 48 px pitch, the standard remedy for crowded x ticks; rendered they do not touch. The bbox code only rotates text for +-90 degrees, so each label keeps its full horizontal width (up to 99 px) and seven overlapping pairs are reported. Rule change: rotate the text bbox for any angle (or at least shrink its horizontal extent by cos(angle)).
